title: ONE WAY TO WRITE NUMBERS
why: His order of 2026-10-09: raid text reads like a shooter HUD. Raid lines wrote the same things several ways: a looted item was labelled 1234c while every other price read $1,234, and time read 12s on the band, 1:30 on the call and 7 min 30 sec on the map, the conditions rows, the downed overlay and the raid clock line. A loot label now reads the value as $1,234, and every raid duration reads 12s below a minute and m:ss from a minute up. Changing the raid length from Settings in a raid now says RAID CLOCK SET TO 7:30 as a system row. The Undercroft panels and the run card keep their written-out times.
now: Loot labels show their value as $1,234, and raid times read 12s or 7:30, never 7 min 30 sec.
